dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan Schedule 3B Support Corridors for potential rapid transit.  Corridors are strategic linear growth areas located along major transportation routes where mixed-use development, intensification, employment, and enhanced mobility are encouraged.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
